messages:
Jordan K: Anyone on SSO/SCIM? Getting alerts for failed SCIM PATCH and SAML metadata fetches since 08:12 UTC. Okta events show 500s and a couple 409s.

Minhee Park: Looking now. Okta event log shows scim.patch failed with `resource_conflict` and SAML metadata fetch from our IdP endpoint returned 502 for ~5 minutes. Could be unrelated but both started close together.

Oliver R: Quick hypothesis: yesterday's RBAC/role-id refactor changed the canonical identifier we use (now prefer externalId over email). If the maintenance job cleared externalIds and Okta still maps externalId, SCIM updates could blow up. SAML 502 might be from our metadata endpoint behind the gateway being rate limited during the reconciliation run.

Jordan K: I see a batch job `identity-maintenance` ran at 07:50 UTC that patched ~200 users to remove stale legacy_id field. Noted some diffs in the PR that touched lookup precedence.

Minhee Park: Reproduced a failing SCIM PATCH locally when externalId is empty but Okta sends an `update` that includes group membership change. Our handler tries to upsert by externalId only and bails if blank -> 409.

Lia S: For SAML: we have scheduled cert rotation next week but no changes today. KMS team rotated a service key at 06:40 UTC which signs our internal service tokens. If tokens are fine, gateway may still reject bursts. Check gateway logs for 502s.

devops-bot: Noted: deployment canary for identity-service started at 07:45 UTC (hash d4f9b1). Health probes returned 502 twice during 07:58-08:03.

Oliver R: OK gateway logs show increased 504/502 during the reconciliation window, likely overloaded by the maintenance job. Also found several token-validation logs showing valid signatures — so KMS rotation validated.

Jordan K: Action plan: 1) Pause identity-maintenance job, 2) push a safe SCIM handler change to fallback to email when externalId missing, 3) run a small reconcile on a handful of impacted tenants. Who can cut the hotfix?

Minhee Park: I'll open a patch: SCIM: if externalId empty -> lookup by userName/email, and log Okta eventId + correlation id. Add unit + integ test for empty externalId case. PR #1682.

Lia S: I'll pause the identity-maintenance cron and notify oncall infra to watch gateway throughput. Also adding a checklist item to the identity playbook: verify SAML cert, validate KMS rotations, and check active maintenance jobs before running large RBAC changes.

Jordan K: Compliance wants full traceability for this incident (Okta event ids, SCIM raw payloads, and audit chain). Our default SCIM audit retention is 30 days. Compliance requests 90 days for SCIM events when customers use SSO. Lia, can you file?

Lia S: Filed SCOM-447 to extend SCIM/SSO audit retention to 90 days and to ensure raw Okta event id is stored (PII redacted). Assigning to logs infra.

devops-bot: PR #1682 passed CI and is deploying to canary (hash d9e7c2).

Minhee Park: Canary tested with Okta test-app: when Okta sends empty externalId, our create/update now falls back to email and returns 200/201 as expected. Added extra logging field `okta_event_id` and `scim_correlation_id`.

Oliver R: After pausing maintenance and rolling hotfix, gateway errors dropped and the backlog of failed SCIM events drained. I kicked a limited reconciliation for 120 users; ~8 duplicates required manual review due to legacy records.

Jordan K: Root cause summary for ticket INFRA-1003: RBAC refactor changed lookup precedence, identity-maintenance job inadvertently nulled identifiers for many accounts, Okta mapping relied on externalId, and SCIM handler lacked fallback. Secondary impact: maintenance run caused traffic spike -> gateway 502s affecting SAML metadata fetches.

Lia S: Remediations: hotfix (email fallback), integration tests for SCIM edge cases, paused and re-run maintenance in controlled batches, extended SCIM audit retention (SCOM-447), added playbook prechecks for KMS rotations and SAML certs, and added a manual reconciliation step for duplicates.

compliance-bot: Compliance notification queued: SSO/SCIM incident on 2026-03-18 08:12 UTC. Audit bundle attached to SCOM-447.

Jordan K: Assigning post-incident to Lia + Minhee for writeup. Also add a regression test into the CI pipeline to prevent future regressions on identifier precedence. Marking as resolved unless objections. :thumbsup:

SAML-bot: Reminder: upcoming SAML cert rotation scheduled 2026-03-25 04:00 UTC. Ensure metadata endpoint reachable. https://internal.redwood/saml/rotations

Oliver R: Noticed one extra risk: our service tokens for SCIM are signed by a key with an automated rotation schedule. Add a CI check that validates new keys against token verification before rotation completes. Filing INFRA-1005.

Minhee Park: I'll add the token-verification check and a small smoke harness for Okta SCIM mapping to the infra repo. PRs linked in the incident ticket.

Jordan K: Thanks all. Closing the thread — will keep SCOM-447 and INFRA-1003 open for follow-ups. Ping if anything drifts tonight.
